the low byte of the constructor's flags (1 makes it load the level file, 0 for a restored game); the constructor tests its own parameter, so nothing reads it
the points of the bricks gone in the current chain of sets (OnBrickGone adds them); PayComboBonus pays them times mChainCount and clears it
the score on the display: catches up with mScore by a step that grows with the gap (Update), and jumps to it when a game is restored
the score (profile setting 0x51); AddScore adds to it and keeps the mode's best; mScoreShown counts up to it on the display
mScore when the game began or when a classic game came out of a warp; profile setting 0x61; a restored score is this plus mPlayPoints and mBonusRoundPoints
the LevelUp value of a level file (10000 by default); nothing reads it
the sets made in a row (AdvanceChain adds one); a chain of 2 or more pays a bonus (PayComboBonus), 3 or more makes a fuel cell due; cleared when the chain ends
the chain count noted when no group was moving (OnBrickArrived); PayComboBonus and ResetGame clear it; nothing reads it
cleared by ResetGame and by each left click that is not refused (MouseDown); nothing reads it
the ship's x in pixels, the left of its column (166 + 44 * column); shots, pick ups and the beam read it; 0x182 after a level file is loaded
the picked-up or caught bricks that have not yet landed in the hand (+1 when taken, -1 in OnBrickLanded); firing, pick up and the pause wait for 0
the bricks taken from the field that have not yet gone: +1 as each goes into mTakenBricks, -1 in OnBrickGone; 0 means no removal is running
the updates between two steps of the ship's warp-out frame (mShipFrame) while the screen fades to white (6 after a level is complete, 8 after a level is loaded)
the ship's sideways shake in pixels while the warp charges, flies and arrives (a random -5 to 5 or -2 to 1 each update); 0 otherwise
the height that the warp pictures at the ship are lifted by; StartLevelUp sets it to 0 and nothing sets another value
the alpha (0 to 255) of the jet and flame flash on the ship while the warp charges: +2 per update, the warp starts at 255 and its sound at 0x96
the alpha (0 to 255) of the glow drawn over the warp picture of the ship; it rises by mWarpGlowStep per update while the field flies away
how much mWarpGlowAlpha rises each update (12, set by StartLevelUp)
counts the calls of UpdateEffects since the level was loaded; a negative value hides the arriving ship's picture
the time played in updates (100 a second) that drives the speed table and, in survival, the stage (6000 a stage); not counted in bonus rounds; profile setting 0x60
the updates of play counted every update that play runs, bonus rounds included; the time on the end page; profile setting 0x54
ResetGame sets it to 500; nothing else writes or reads it
copy of mRowsToPass made whenever a level's rules are set; AddTopRow runs while it is not 0 (the port never counts it down)
the rows a stage takes to pass (NumRowsToPass: 25 by default, grows by mRowsToPassChange each stage, at most 70)
how much mRowsToPass grows each stage (NumRowsToPassChangeBy of the level file, else 0)
the time in updates between top rows (DropTime * 100 of the level file); UpdateRamp sets it from the speed table
how much shorter the row interval has become: +1 every mRowReductionPeriod updates while play runs, never more than mRowInterval - 200
the updates between two steps of mRowIntervalReduction (8, one less on each even stage from the mode's start stage on, at least 5)
the updates since the last top row finished bouncing (0 in OnBrickBounced, -1 after a reset); the next row comes when it reaches the row time
the points of the bricks of the current removal; OnBrickGone adds them and the group's floating text shows them where the first brick was
alpha 0-255 of the warp screen's gates: 0 on reaching the gates, +2 an update up to 255 (UpdateWarp); DrawWarpScreen fades the gates in with it
glow alpha 0-255 of the easy gate: +8 an update while the pointer is over it, -8 otherwise (UpdateWarp); the pointer is never over it and nothing reads it
glow alpha 0-255 of the slow gate: +8 an update while the pointer is over it, -8 otherwise (UpdateWarp); DrawWarpScreen draws the gate again with it
glow alpha 0-255 of the fast gate, moved like mSlowGateGlow by the pointer; drawn only when the fast gate is offered
alpha of the lightning flash on the warp backdrop: 0xff when a flash starts, -3 an update to 0 (UpdateScenery); drawn in 3D while the warp runs
the updates between two lightning flashes of the warp (100-299, drawn again after each flash); a flash starts when mUpdateCnt is a multiple of it
the y (50-399) at which the lightning picture is drawn, drawn again at each flash
the updates the freeze effect has left (1000 from BeginClearWait, counts down once the game runs); the freeze ends and event 0x28 (0) fires at 0
the stage after the one the game began on (mStageNumber + 1 in the constructor, aLevel + 1 for a classic game); nothing reads it
the stage the slow gate of the warp screen leads to (the current stage + 2); a click on the gate advances mStageNumber up to it
the stage the fast gate leads to (a jump of up to 8 stages ahead); -1 when no fast gate is offered; its level is this / 2 + 1
the furthest level the player has reached with this pilot (profile record mMode + 8); the fast gate needs it above 3 and stages up to twice it minus 2
cleared in ResetGame beside the stage's brick count; nothing else reads or writes it
the bricks cleared toward the stage's quota mBricksToPass (OnBrickGone counts each; a booster adds 15%); saved in profile record 0x56; the brickometer fill
the stage's quota of bricks (NumBricksToPass of the level file: 200 for level 1, then plus mBricksToPassChange, at most mBricksToPassMax)
how much the quota mBricksToPass grows for each level (NumBricksToPassChangeBy of the level file, 20 for level 1)
the highest the quota mBricksToPass may grow (MaxBricksToPass of the global rules, 1000)
the longest chain of the game outside bonus rounds (AdvanceChain); saving the game raises it to mBestChain; nothing else reads it
the colours in play beyond the first four (0-2): the level file's AddNewColor adds one, survival adds one at ramp time 18000; bricks are made from 4 + this kinds
the updates since the first set of the stage while the time bonus runs (PayTimeBonus pays at 200..700); 0 when it stops
the steps of the time bonus paid so far (0-6, at 200, 300, 400, 500, 600 and 700 updates); sets the height of the bonus's floating text
1 while the pilot's power-up is running (the gauge full and the weapon in use), 0 while it charges; set in BeginPlay, cleared when the gauge is empty
the pilot of the game (0 laser, 1 atomic, 2 turbot, 3 psychic) and the base of its profile records: best score at mMode, stage at +4, level at +8
0 when the atomic weapon (mode 1) is fired in BeginPlay, -1 once its blast has gone; nothing reads it
updates since the eighth atomic explosion reached frame 7 (the atomic symbol fades in with twice it as alpha); past 149 it becomes -5 and the blast sounds; -1 none
alpha of the white flash over the screen while the atomic blast grows (0 at its start, +1 an update, +10 later up to 255); -1 when no blast runs
the y of the turbot's wave picture: starts at the screen's height and falls 10 an update while the wave sweeps; -65536 when none
the white flash of the turbot mode: counts up to 100 while it charges (it also sets the beams' rate), 255 when the wave starts, then -2 an update; -1 none
the chains begun since the time bonus clock started (AdvanceChain); the first starts the clock, and PayTimeBonus needs 3 to 8 of them for each step
the number of bricks of one kind together that make a set and are taken out (4); the bot and the move search use it too
the tutorial's updates since the first brick was picked up; at 1000 the tutorial's hint dialog opens; restarted by the second pick-up
the bricks picked up so far while the tutorial is on (counted in the pick-up loop of the hand); the first one starts mTutorialPickTimer
the kind of game this Board plays: 0 the demonstration, 1 the classic game, 2 survival (constructor argument); also the table of its Hall of Fame records
the bricks that rise on a support brick (event 0x10 from Brick::SetTargetY counts up, 0x11 from FireLanded down); the next row waits for 0
the x of the slow gate on the warp screen: 182 when two gates are shown, else centred; its click area is 120 wide
the x of the fast gate on the warp screen (402); -1 when none is offered
set to 0 in the constructor beside the screen wipe; nothing reads it
the updates until the siren and its song stop after the stack has dropped below 13 rows (300 / (15 - height), CheckStackHeight); -1 none
the x shift of the frame, the panels and the logo: random -2..2 while a strong hit shakes (UpdateStartBanner), -5..5 in turbot mode and at the game's end; else 0
the steps the screen wipe runs each update: 2000 for the kind that ends at once, 4 for kind 3, else 6
the brick type that counts toward the quota (OnBrickGone); -1 counts every brick, the only value ever set
the power level of the pilot's weapon (profile record mMode + 0x33): the reach of the pointer's marking, and the share of buried bricks the atomic weapon takes
the level of the weapon's duration for the laser (profile record 0x37) or the psychic (0x3a), -1 for the others; ApplyWeaponLevels picks how long it lasts from it
the level of the weapon's charging speed (profile record mMode + 0x3b): ApplyWeaponLevels turns it into the gauge's charge factor
the y of the game-over danger picture: mUpdateCnt + 20 when the siren starts, -12 an update (UpdateAlertFlash); -500000000 none; nothing draws it
counts the 149 updates the danger picture waits once it passes y 21; -500000000 before, -250000000 after
alpha 0-255 of the turbot's power-up drawn on the ship: 0 at BeginPlay, +2 an update
the step of mDangerPulseAlpha each update; its size comes from the stack height (CheckStackHeight) and its sign flips at either end
the pulsing alpha 0-255 of the danger zone's second layer while the stack is high (UpdateAlertFlash)
alpha 0-255 of the glow at the bottom of the screen: +4 an update while the stack is 14 rows or more, -6 otherwise
which warp gate the pointer is over (2 the slow gate, 3 the fast gate, 0 none); nothing reads it
a countdown from 100 held between extra rows: set when extra rows become due, counts down while no power-up runs; an extra row waits until it is 0
the game's phase: index of the picture under the field (mPhasePictures) and key of PickSpawnDelay; 2-5 calm, 6-7 power-up, 8-9 siren, 10-13 chain flurry
the updates left of the chain flurry (chain length x 100 after a chain over 2, 400 at a bonus round, 700 at the level-up screen); at 0 the phase goes back
the updates until the phase steps on again (PickSpawnDelay of the current phase); the power-up picture fades with it
the most mutators that may be in the field at once (MaxMutators of the level file, 6 by default; the speed ramp changes it)
the rows the field is filled with at the start of a level (NumRowsAtStart of the level file, 4 by default)
how much of the SUPA banner's title is shown, 0-10 (the index of its width table); +1 every 4 updates while the banner opens
the hue 0-255 of the running banner text while the power-up runs: +4 an update; 0 at BeginPlay
the step of the SUPA banner: 0 none, 1 brackets slide in, 2 spread, 3 title, 4 name, 5 hold, 6 slide out (UpdateStartBanner)
the y of the SUPA banner's brackets: slides in from above the screen to 0 and back out
how far apart the banner's two brackets have slid, 0 to 231 (+12 an update in step 2)
how white the banner's brackets are, 255 at the start and -3 an update to 0 (their green and blue); drawn red at 0
alpha 0-255 of the weapon's name in the banner: +10 an update in step 4
counts updates inside a banner step: 4 for each step of the title, 149 for the hold
the updates of screen shake left (25 when the laser takes a brick or the psychic pops its bricks); each update sets mScreenShakeX at random
mUpdateCnt when the game was paused (Pause); the drawing uses it as its tick while the pause lasts so the animations stand still
mUpdateCnt when the game was resumed from a pause; clicks in that same update are ignored
the colour of the combo display: 0 blue, 1 red, 2 yellow; moves on each time a chain reaches 2
the updates the combo display stays up (300, or 600 for a chain over 5); the combo count is cleared when it runs out
chain length shown as the combo text 'x<n>' (picks the combo list row and font, DrawLogo); AdvanceChain sets it for chains of 2+, cleared when mComboTimeLeft ends
hue 0-255 of the special banner texts: +4 (mod 256) an update while mSpecialBannerTexts is not empty (UpdateStates), drawn through HSLToRGB
updates until the next extra top row falls due (mExtraRowsDue +1, then reloaded from mExtraRowInterval); counts from mHardStage on while play runs unfrozen (UpdateStates)
updates between extra top rows: (mHardStage - stage + 60) * 100, at least 4500, set when a stage is set up; halved at each extra row down to 300; 500000000 at start
power brick rows from mHardStage on (FillTopRow): 0 start, -1 none due, 1 or 2 a new row of that third of the stage gets a power brick, 3 given; ResetGame clears it
cel of IMAGE_CP_WARP_OVERLAY drawn over the field while the warp runs: +1 every 5 updates, wrapping at the cel count (UpdateWarp)
updates until the combo bonus is paid (PayComboBonus): 100 at every chain step (AdvanceChain), counted down by UpdateStates
levels completed in this game: the first level minus 1 (0 for a new game), +1 in LevelComplete; saved as profile setting 0x55 and restored; nothing else reads it
y the flames of a booster brick fly to, the top of the brickometer fill plus 48 (OnHyperBrick); handed to the PowerBrick as mBoosterY
cel of the sprocket overlay on the bricks while the atomic weapon (mode 1) runs: +1 every 10 updates, wrapping at the cel count, sent to the bricks as event 0x22
kind of the screen the next level begins with (UpgradeScreenKind: 0 plain, 1 bonus round, 2 upgrade, 3 mode unlock, 4 both); drawn on the slow gate
kind (same codes) of the screen that ends the level being played: copied from mNextLevelScreenKind in LoadLevel, saved as setting 99; picks bonus round, upgrade, unlock
row in the profile's top-5 records of the game that has ended (AddRecord's result, -1 none): 0 plays the new high score sound, DrawEndPage lights the row
counts up by 4 (mod 256) every update while the game ends (UpdateGameOver); nothing reads it
alpha 0-255 of the ship's flame and charge shimmer while mStreaksFadingOut: 0 in LoadLevel, +2 an update up to 255 (UpdateEffects)
darkening of the frame, 0-128 (drawn shade is 255 minus it): +1 an update while the stack is high and the weapon meter full and idle, -2 otherwise (UpdateAlertFlash)
updates left of the survival bonus display after a supercharge blast: 200 at the start, counted down by UpdateSparks; DrawSurvivalBonus shows it, sparks fall meanwhile
updates before a new rank is announced: 100 (1 if the upgrade dialog was seen) when the warp panel finds a rank above the best (UpdateWarp); 0 sets mNewRankDelayOver
x of the supa weapon's button on the frame: slides in (+2) from minus the width of IMAGE_SUPA_BUTTON_ALERT to 0 when the meter is full, out (-3) while the weapon runs
phase of the turbot weapon (mode 2): 0 start, 1 field swept, 2 flash done, 3 both done and the wave rises; SweepTurbots and UpdateSpecialMode step it, BeginPlay clears it
cel of the turbot overlay on the bricks while the turbot weapon (mode 2) runs: +1 every 10 updates, wrapping at the cel count, sent to the bricks as event 0x24
counts 0 to 100 once mTurbotPhase is 3; at 100 the flash goes full and the weapon's animation stops, then the wave rises (UpdateSpecialMode); BeginPlay clears it
updates between new turbot beams: 15 at the start, then 15 minus a tenth of mTurbotFlashAlpha at each beam (UpdateSpecialMode); a beam starts at a multiple of it
updates left before a mutator brick (kind 0xc) may be made again: 2000 whenever no brick is mutating, counted down while play runs (UpdateStates); CanPlaceKind refuses it
alpha 0-255 of the PERFECT picture shown after ClearBonus: +8 an update up to 255, held, then -3 down to 0 (UpdateStates)
state of the PERFECT picture: 0 none, 1 fading in, 2 held (mPerfectBannerHold), 3 fading out; ClearBonus sets 1, LevelComplete and ResetGame clear it
updates the PERFECT picture is held at full alpha: 175 set by ClearBonus, counted down in state 2 of mPerfectBannerState
the level a classic game continues from: the mode's best level rounded down to a multiple of four, -1 if below four; set when the game ends, shown on the end page +1
updates left of the bonus round: 6000 (60 s at 100 an update) once its bricks are shown, -1 before; at 0 the clear count starts; OnHyperBrick adds 300; saved as 0x57
alpha 0-255 of the bonus round's fade-out: 0xff when the round is loaded, -2 an update while mBonusFadingOut (UpdateIntroAndTally)
200 when a bonus round warp starts or is restored, 300 when its bricks have all been revealed; nothing reads it
updates left of the banner made by BuildBanner (400); counted down in a bonus round while no supa banner runs; clicks and the tally wait until it is 0
the whole time of the banner in updates, as BuildBanner was given it; AnimateBanner fades the banner in over its first 75 updates with it
time left of the banner as of the last update (mBannerTimeLeft before its decrement); AnimateBanner fades the banner out over its last 75 updates with it
width in pixels of the dark bars that close in from the two sides of the field at the start of the clear count: +8 an update up to 320
alpha 0-255 of the tally's title text (DrawBonusStats): +8 an update in state 1 of mTallyState
updates the clear count tally waits before its next step (UpdateIntroAndTally), counted down; the next value depends on the state (128 at the start, 25, 3, 10, 20, 400)
bricks left when the clear count started (rows 1 down plus the held bricks, StartClearCount); 0 means a clean field and its bonus
bricks counted so far by the tally, up to mTallyBricksLeft; also saved as profile setting 100 when a bonus round is built
the penalty of the bricks left: mTallyBricksLeft times a twentieth of mClearBonusWorth, at most mClearBonusWorth
the penalty counted up so far on the tally, rising by mTallyAmountStep per brick to mTallyPenalty
the bonus for a clean field: mClearBonusWorth when no brick was left, else 0; the stage total is mClearBonusWorth minus mTallyPenalty plus this
the clean-field bonus counted up so far on the tally, rising by mTallyAmountStep to mTallyCleanBonus
what has been paid into the score so far from the tally's total, at mTallyAmountStep an update (state 6 of mTallyState)
step of the clear count tally 0-8: 0 bars close, 1 title, 2 and 3 bricks and penalty counted, 4 and 5 clean bonus, 6 total paid, 8 the end; a click jumps to 6
the amount the tally adds per count: the penalty of one brick, then (by the size of the total) 500, 1000, 2000 or 4000 for paying it into the score
counts the tally's steps so that the count sound plays on every second, fourth or eighth one (UpdateIntroAndTally)
the stage from which the game turns harder: 3 in the demonstration, 5 in the classic game, 500000000 (never) in survival; boosters, power rows, extra rows, quicker pieces
part of the warp into a bonus round while mBonusWarpIn: 1 the streaks run and the screen goes white, 2 white holds, 3 the streaks slow and the white fades; 0 not running
counts the updates the white screen holds in part 2 of the bonus warp, up to 50 (UpdateIntroAndTally)
alpha 0-255 of the white overlay in the bonus warp: +1 every second update in part 1 (to 80), 255 in part 2, -2 an update in part 3
the constructor clears it among the bonus warp fields; nothing else writes or reads it
x that centres a text of the bonus warp on 386 (UpdateIntroAndTally and RestoreGame set it from the width of the font); nothing reads it
the number of the rank of mScore (AstroPopApp::GetRankName), taken when the level-up text is made; its picture is mRankImage; above profile setting 0x71 it is a new rank
the weapon's charge, 0 to mWeaponChargeMax: rises by mWeaponChargeStep an update while idle, falls by mWeaponDrainStep while the weapon runs; saved as setting 0x50
the charge at which the weapon is ready: 18000 (set by the constructor and ApplyWeaponLevels); the meter is full when mWeaponCharge reaches it
how much mWeaponCharge falls an update while the weapon runs, set by ApplyWeaponLevels from the pilot's duration level; the seconds shown are the charge over it over 100
how much mWeaponCharge rises an update while the field is quiet (a factor, 1.2 and up), set by ApplyWeaponLevels from mWeaponChargeLevel
chance (0-1) of a power brick in a new row: BonusChance of the level file, moved by mBonusChanceChange each level and interpolated along mSpeedRamp (FillTopRow)
chance (0-1) of a penalty brick (stone, steel, mutator) in a new row: PenaltyChance of the level file, moved by mPenaltyChanceChange each level, along mSpeedRamp too
how much mBonusChance changes by each level (BonusChanceChangeBy of the level file, 0 if absent)
how much mPenaltyChance changes by each level (PenaltyChanceChangeBy of the level file, 0 if absent)
how far the ship is pushed down from its resting row when a brick lands on it: 0 to 5 pixels, -1 while at rest; ResetGame sets -1, the landing sets 0
the step of mShipBounceY an update: 1.0 down, its sign turns at 5 and again on reaching the rest (ResetGame sets 1.0)
how much the backdrop scroll is slowed (at most 9) in part 3 of the bonus warp: +0.09 an update from 0, the part ends at 9 (UpdateIntroAndTally, StepScrollLayer)
updates a mutating brick waits before it drops (Brick::Update against mMutateTimer): 1000 at start, 900 at setup, MutationDelay of the level file, along mSpeedRamp too
the pilot's weapon box is still to be shown at the first move: profile setting 0x2a plus mode is 1 (read in BeginPlay); StartByHand opens it, hints turned on again set it
set when the options box is closed with its own button (ApplyOptions) and during CloseStory: Pause's resume then leaves the loop sounds muted
